item.title: Former Australian soldier charged with committing 5 war crime murders in Afghanistan
item.summary: A former Australian soldier has been charged with war crimes on allegations that he killed five unarmed Afghans while serving in Afghanistan from 2009 and 2012

item.title: China says Afghanistan and Pakistan agreed to explore a 'comprehensive solution'
item.summary: China’s government has said that Afghanistan and Pakistan agreed not to escalate their conflict and to “explore a comprehensive solution” after several weeks of cross-border fighting between the two countries that has left hundreds of people killed

item.title: Gunmen attack building housing Israeli Consulate in Istanbul
item.summary: Turkish officials say that gunmen attacked a building housing the Israeli Consulate in Istanbul, sparking a gunfight that left one assailant dead and two police officers wounded

item.title: Pope says Trump's threat to destroy Iranian civilization is 'unacceptable'
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV says that U.S. President Donald Trump’s threat to destroy Iranian civilization is “truly unacceptable” and that any attacks on civilian infrastructure violate international law

item.title: French train driver killed, 16 injured in a railway crossing crash
item.summary: A French high-speed train driver has died after his train collided with a truck carrying military equipment in northern France

item.title: Hundreds of Cuban women rally against US energy blockade as crisis deepens
item.summary: Hundreds of Cuban women have gathered in Havana to decry a U.S. energy embargo and other measures imposed by U.S. President Donald Trump that are strangling the Caribbean island

item.title: North Korea fires missiles toward sea after ridiculing South's hopes for better ties
item.summary: South Korea’s military says it detected North Korea firing several short-range ballistic missiles toward the sea

item.title: Japanese national believed to be NHK journalist detained in Iran released on bail
item.summary: Japan’s top government spokesperson says a Japanese national who had been detained in Iran since January has been released on bail

item.title: Dominican officials to cancel classes, warning of flooding and power outages
item.summary: Heavy rains in the Dominican Republic are causing power outages and forcing officials to suspend classes at some public and private schools

item.title: Bahamian officials search for missing US woman after husband says she fell overboard
item.summary: Authorities in the Bahamas are searching for a U.S. woman who is missing at sea after her husband reported that she fell overboard
